name: Jaroslav Bžoch - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland on the transfer of passenger name record (PNR) data for the prevention, detection, investigation and prosecution of terrorist offences and serious crime
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new deal between the European Union and Iceland. Under it, airlines will send passenger information, such as travel details, to Iceland's authorities. They will use it to spot possible terrorists and serious criminals, including people the police do not yet know. The deal sets rules on how the data is stored, used and kept, and on how people can complain. The Parliament's data protection watchdog supports it.

- Airlines will pass passenger data to Iceland's authorities for security checks.
- It affects travellers flying to or from Iceland and Iceland's police and border staff.
- The deal can now be formally concluded; the Parliament has approved it.
